description: Hardcoded knowledge for Frontend Developer Agent - no codebase search needed

coreLearnings.content: Frontend uses React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS with MUI v7 and Radix UI components
State management: Zustand for global state, TanStack Query for server state, React Query for caching
517 TypeScript/TSX files in frontend codebase organized by features in src/features/
API client located at src/api/client.ts using Axios with interceptors for auth tokens

All API files: auth, buildCharts, cfo, costGroups, diningTables, goodsReceipts, guestCount, ingredients, inventory, invoices, kpi, labor, manuals, menuEngineering, menuItems, orders, primeCost, purchaseOrders, recipes, restaurant, sessions, suppliers, unitConversion, weeklyBudget

Features: auth, dashboard, build-charts, experiments, inventory, kds, menu-costing, menu-engineering, operations-manual, payments, pos, prime-cost, purchase, purchasing, recipes, recipes-menu, reports, settings, unit-converter
Components: charts (recharts), kpi, layout (Header, Sidebar, MainLayout), notifications, search, shared, ui (Button, Card, Dialog, Input, Select, Table, Tabs)
Real-time: WebSocket via STOMP/sockjs-client for KDS (Kitchen Display System) updates
Routing: React Router DOM v7 in src/router/
Forms: React Hook Form + Zod for validation in most features
Design system: Custom fonts (DMSans, DMMono, PlayfairDisplay) in src/assets/fonts/
Canvas drawing: Konva + react-konva for floor plan / table layout editor
i18n: i18next with locales in src/locales/
Testing: Playwright for E2E tests in e2e/ folder with test-results/
Build output: dist/ folder deployed via Docker with nginx

stores.auth: src/stores/authStore.ts - Zustand store for authentication state
stores.app: src/stores/appStore.ts - Zustand store for app-wide state

patternsEstablished: API calls use TanStack Query hooks: useQuery for GET, useMutation for POST/PUT/DELETE
Forms use React Hook Form with Zod schema validation
Components use Tailwind CSS classes with clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional classes
Modals use Radix UI Dialog component
Tables use custom Table component with sorting and pagination
Real-time updates via WebSocket STOMP messages for KDS
Protected routes check authentication state from Zustand auth store
API base URL configured in src/api/client.ts

commonErrors.CORS errors: Backend not allowing frontend origin - check backend CORS config
commonErrors.401 Unauthorized: Token expired or not sent - check auth interceptor
commonErrors.React key warning: Missing key prop in list items
commonErrors.Hydration mismatch: SSR/SSG data not matching client - use useEffect for client-only

knownPitfalls: Large bundle size - consider code splitting for features
Some components missing proper error boundaries
Need to add loading skeletons for async data
Ensure dark mode compatibility for all components
